name: geoatlas
description: ГеоАтлас — визуализатор сетевых взаимодействий по syslog МСЭ: парсинг, GeoIP, карта связей, аномалии, ClickHouse.

fields.sites_https_justification: GitHub repository and releases over HTTPS: https://github.com/varlahin-gena/geoatlas
fields.maintained_justification: Active releases and vulnerability response SLA: https://github.com/varlahin-gena/geoatlas/blob/main/SECURITY.md https://github.com/varlahin-gena/geoatlas/releases
fields.version_unique_justification: VERSION file and git tags vX.Y.Z: https://github.com/varlahin-gena/geoatlas/blob/main/VERSION https://github.com/varlahin-gena/geoatlas/releases
fields.release_notes_vulns_justification: No publicly known product CVEs with assignments at recent release time; security notes go in CHANGELOG Security when applicable: https://github.com/varlahin-gena/geoatlas/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md
fields.vulnerability_report_private_justificati: Private GitHub Security Advisories linked from https://github.com/varlahin-gena/geoatlas/blob/main/SECURITY.md and https://github.com/varlahin-gena/geoatlas/security/advisories/new
fields.vulnerability_report_response_justificat: No vulnerability reports received in the last 6 months; SLA documented in https://github.com/varlahin-gena/geoatlas/blob/main/SECURITY.md
fields.build_justification: Docker Compose / start.sh rebuild from source: https://github.com/varlahin-gena/geoatlas/blob/main/docs/development.md
fields.build_floss_tools_justification: Build uses FLOSS tools (Go, Node, Docker): https://github.com/varlahin-gena/geoatlas/blob/main/docs/development.md
fields.test_justification: go test / npm test documented and run in CI: https://github.com/varlahin-gena/geoatlas/blob/main/docs/development.md https://github.com/varlahin-gena/geoatlas/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml
fields.test_invocation_justification: Standard go test ./... and npm test: https://github.com/varlahin-gena/geoatlas/blob/main/docs/development.md
fields.test_most_justification: Automated suites cover major modules; expanded with features: https://github.com/varlahin-gena/geoatlas/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml
fields.tests_are_added_justification: Major features land with tests via PRs under https://github.com/varlahin-gena/geoatlas/pulls
fields.warnings_justification: golangci-lint and frontend typecheck/lint in CI: https://github.com/varlahin-gena/geoatlas/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml
fields.know_secure_design_justification: Primary developer applies secure design (deny-by-default auth, least privilege roles, proxy gate): https://github.com/varlahin-gena/geoatlas/blob/main/SECURITY.md https://github.com/varlahin-gena/geoatlas/blob/main/README.md
fields.know_common_errors_justification: Common web/app errors mitigated (authz, CSRF/session, injection at ingest boundaries): https://github.com/varlahin-gena/geoatlas/blob/main/SECURITY.md https://github.com/varlahin-gena/geoatlas/blob/main/docs/architecture.md
fields.crypto_published_justification: TLS at nginx edge; standard published algorithms via platform libs: https://github.com/varlahin-gena/geoatlas/blob/main/README.md
fields.crypto_call_justification: Passwords via golang.org/x/crypto/bcrypt; no custom crypto: https://github.com/varlahin-gena/geoatlas/blob/main/backend/internal/auth/users.go
fields.crypto_floss_justification: FLOSS crypto libraries (Go x/crypto, TLS stack): https://github.com/varlahin-gena/geoatlas/blob/main/backend/go.mod
fields.crypto_keylength_justification: TLS terminated at nginx with modern defaults; app secrets generated as high-entropy tokens: https://github.com/varlahin-gena/geoatlas/blob/main/docs/configuration.md
fields.crypto_working_justification: Defaults avoid broken algorithms (MD5/DES/RC4); bcrypt for password storage: https://github.com/varlahin-gena/geoatlas/blob/main/backend/internal/auth/users.go
fields.crypto_weaknesses_justification: Modern TLS and bcrypt; no SHA-1 password hashing: https://github.com/varlahin-gena/geoatlas/blob/main/backend/internal/auth/users.go
fields.crypto_pfs_justification: No application-level key agreement; PFS provided by TLS at nginx when HTTPS is enabled: https://github.com/varlahin-gena/geoatlas/blob/main/docs/install.md
fields.delivery_unsigned_justification: sha256 checksums distributed over HTTPS with the release: https://github.com/varlahin-gena/geoatlas/blob/main/docs/install.md
fields.vulnerabilities_fixed_60_days_justificat: No known unpatched medium+ product vulnerabilities older than 60 days; process in https://github.com/varlahin-gena/geoatlas/blob/main/SECURITY.md
fields.vulnerabilities_critical_fixed_justifica: Critical issues handled via private advisory + release: https://github.com/varlahin-gena/geoatlas/blob/main/SECURITY.md
fields.no_leaked_credentials_justification: gitleaks in CI; secrets stay in local .env: https://github.com/varlahin-gena/geoatlas/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml https://github.com/varlahin-gena/geoatlas/blob/main/.gitleaks.toml
fields.static_analysis_fixed_justification: CI fails on high/critical findings per workflow policy: https://github.com/varlahin-gena/geoatlas/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml https://github.com/varlahin-gena/geoatlas/blob/main/.github/workflows/image-scan.yml
fields.dynamic_analysis_justification: Automated tests and integration jobs in CI (including fuzz where present): https://github.com/varlahin-gena/geoatlas/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml
fields.dynamic_analysis_fixed_justification: No medium+ exploitable vulnerabilities currently outstanding from dynamic analysis; CI gates regressions: https://github.com/varlahin-gena/geoatlas/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml
